method: Production pack, InputCoordinator, actual visible literal suggestions, FakeDocument with selections at document end only
finding: Picking the selected word unchanged clears core editing state but leaves host selection active; following letters replace the selected word

controls.different_surface_control: Direct pickSuggestion(kalem) replaces selection and consumes it; lar then appends. This does not claim kalem was visible.
controls.direct_typing_control: Without confirming, lar replacing selected word is expected
controls.space: Also leaves selection active; existing comments deliberately preserve selection on no correction, so not counted as separate defect

existing_test_gap: testCommittingTheSameSurfaceIsHarmless checks text immediately after pick, not host selection or subsequent typing
limitations: No UIKit simulator interaction in this run
Selection remains host-visible; not claiming hidden selection
Mid-document cursor behavior not tested because FakeDocument cannot model it accurately
